name: SEG International Bhd
overview: 2026年，SEG International 的公告主要涉及季度业绩、股息派发、股东授权更新及关联方交易，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、收缩、出售或新合约。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长18.5%，净利润同比增长1302.4%。
overview_en: In 2026, SEG International's announcements mainly covered quarterly results, dividend payment, renewal of shareholders' mandate and related party transactions, with no disclosure of expansion, contraction, disposal or new contracts in any business segment. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue grew 18.5% YoY and net profit grew 1302.4% YoY.
